title: RNA Isolation from Yeast
author: Tara Stuecker
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.inwcdfe

steps.title: Harvest and Freeze Yeast Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 10–15 ml of yeast cells (ideally mid-exponentially growing, OD 600 ~0.3-0.6) in a 15-ml conical tube at 1,500 rcf at room temperature for 3 min.

substeps.instruction: Decant the supernatant.
Freeze the cell pellets in liquid nitrogen (or store at -80°C for several months).

steps.title: Cell Lysis
steps.instruction: Lyse the frozen cell pellet using acid saturated phenol and lysis buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.4, 10 mM EDTA, 0.5% SDS).

substeps.instruction: Add 800 µl of acid saturated phenol to the frozen pellet first (do not let cells thaw before adding phenol).
Add 800 µl of lysis buffer.
Vortex until pellets are in solution.
Place tubes in a MultiTherm pre-heated to 65°C.
Vortex at maximum intensity for 45 min at 65°C.

steps.title: Phase Separation and RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform sequential extractions to isolate the aqueous phase containing RNA, ensuring no organic layer is transferred.

substeps.instruction: Transfer lysate to an RNase-free 2-ml tube and centrifuge for 10 min at max speed at 4°C.
Transfer the top aqueous phase into a fresh RNase-free 2-ml tube containing 800 µl phenol; vortex briefly and centrifuge for 5 min at 5,000 rpm at room temperature.
If a fluffy precipitate remains at the interphase, repeat the phenol extraction a third time.
Transfer the top aqueous phase into a fresh RNase-free 2-ml tube containing 800 µl chloroform; vortex briefly and centrifuge for 5 min at 5,000 rpm at room temperature.
Transfer the final aqueous phase into a fresh RNase-free 2-ml tube.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation and Washing
steps.instruction: Precipitate the RNA from the aqueous phase using sodium acetate and ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 75 µl 3 M NaOAc pH 5.2 (0.1 volume) and ~1.8 ml 100% ethanol (~2.5 volumes).
Incubate tubes at -20°C for >2 hours (overnight is preferred).
Pellet RNA by centrifuging at max speed for 30 min at 4°C.
Carefully decant supernatant and add 1 ml 70% EtOH to wash the pellet.
Centrifuge at max speed for 15 min at 4°C.
Remove ethanol using a 1-ml RNase-free pipette tip.
Centrifuge briefly (1-2 min) at max speed and remove residual ethanol with a 10-ul RNase-free pipette tip.

steps.title: RNA Resuspension and Storage
steps.instruction: Resuspend the purified RNA pellet in TE buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA).

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 50 µl RNase-free TE by pipetting up and down.
Measure RNA concentration and purity via spectrophotometer (Nanodrop) or Qubit (Expected A260/A280 >2.0 and A260/A230 ~2.2 or slightly above).
Store RNA at -80°C.
